title: Arisen brain: backing off into a wall
intro: ARCHER Arisen, not possessing, no wild enemies near. You will stand him with his BACK to a wall. A dummy appears close in front, so he tries to back off into the wall.

steps.text: Stand the Arisen with his BACK about 2-3 m from a wall or cliff face, FACING open ground. Press End
Dummy appears 4 m in front of him
Hands off - watch: he backs into the wall. Does he steer along it, or stand and fight, instead of running at it?

expect.label: he noticed he was stuck and steered

probes.brain: local d = H.dpc_brain(); return d and (tostring(d.mode) .. ' | blocked=' .. tostring(d.los_blocked) .. ' | presses=' .. tostring(d.presses)) or 'n/a'
probes.ehp:
local function nearest()
  local a = H.arisen(); if not a then return nil end
  local ap = a:call("get_Transform"):call("get_Position")
  local em = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.EnemyManager")
  local arr = em and em:call("getAllEnemies"); if not arr then return nil end
  local best, bd
  for i = 0, arr:call("get_Count") - 1 do
    local ok, e = pcall(function() return arr[i]:get_field("_Chara") end)
    if ok and e and (e:call("get_Hp") or 0) > 0 then
      local p = e:call("get_Transform"):call("get_Position")
      local d = math.sqrt((p.x - ap.x) ^ 2 + (p.z - ap.z) ^ 2)
      if not bd or d < bd then best, bd = e, d end
    end
  end
  return best, bd
end
local e = nearest(); return e and e:call('get_Hp')
